## Change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. For model changes, include
source/checkpoint revisions and the runtime environment. Identify unverified cases.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and upstream attribution is preserved.
- [ ] Relevant source/tooling checks pass.
- [ ] User-facing docs and support status match the evidence.
- [ ] New integration files are listed in `project-manifest.json`.
- [ ] No credentials, model weights, or private recordings are included.
